title: Thin, cheap feeling and not good enough for regular use
text: Thin, cheap feeling and not good enough for regular use. Very, very thin! The grey color is gorgeous and the four pillow cases with the twin set was a nice bonus and the saving grace. These are strictly a back up set for unexpected guests and definitely NOT good enough quality for regular use. The sheets have a distinct polyester, cheap feel against the skin.

features: All Sizes have 4 pillowcases, even Twin!

description: Unequaled quality and value... Treat yourself today!
D. Charles, a name that has been behind the scenes designing fine fabrics and home products for more than 40 years, has created a sheet that sets itself apart.
We start with finer microfiber yarns and then weave it into a supple fabric that is brushed using a special process that creates a soft, cotton-like finish.
We call it a NearCotton(tm) finish because while it’s not 100% cotton, it feels incredibly soft and luxurious.
Microfiber has benefits that set it apart from similarly priced polyester or cotton blends:
Hypoallergenic and Breathable – better air flow than other blended polyester sheets.
Virtually wrinkle free if put on the bed or folded immediately after drying.
2 additional pillowcases (4 total), even in Twin!
12" Pockets on Twin and Full fit up to 15" Deep Mattress
Flat Sheet 92 x 64" Fitted: 39 x 75" Pillowcases: 20 X 30"
